purpose: Combine registered preparation interests with ordinary parallel original saves, actual MiniLM hooks, preparation drain and restart

conditions.name: skipped-cut
conditions.preparation: A1/B1 captured unprepared, A2/B2 prepared first; 80 hooks must obtain their captured cuts through ordinary shared preparation

checks: real Pre/Post/Stop fixture creates captured original boundary and original JSON evidence
80 ordinary deliverForWork requests preserve both original values and exclude a later foreign publication
80 parallel saves retain checked durable ACKs across independent project original owners
queued expiry, isolated cancellation, completed empty response, worker reuse and invalid save rejection remain correct
all 80 ACKed original response atoms materialize exactly
all current write-source MiniLM windows are prepared and valid after ordinary background drain
fresh capture clears all prior original/prepared/private boundary fields before establishing a new turn
newly stored original is delivered to a new chat before and after actual service shutdown/restart
no waiter grants, references or charged preparation metadata remain after completion
skipped-cut fixtures freeze their two required original values before any hook delivery and exclude NEW_ID_BETA later originals
failureRule: Retain a failed attempt and its first failing stage. Do not rerun it unchanged or relabel it as a success. A runtime change restarts the three-trial series.
cleanup: Delete ended fixture DB/cache/raw logs after extracting compact evidence, without archives. Keep protected originals and required build inputs.
